description: messy/trap: Pflegefachhelferin is the 1-year HELPER qualification, not the 3-year Pflegefachkraft, despite the 'Fach' in its name (qualification_knowledge.json's own documented trap). The candidate's own sentence also names the Pflegefachkräfte she assists, which trips the deterministic per-line job-title classifier into wrongly crediting her with the pflegefachkraft role too. LLM won this one decisively, see evals/cv/README.md
